name: NGC 3842 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 3842, a giant elliptical galaxy at the heart of the galaxy cluster Abell 1367, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc3842-hubble
story: NGC 3842 is the brightest galaxy of the cluster Abell 1367, and its center hides a black hole of 9.7 billion solar masses. Hubble took this picture to count the globular clusters swarming around it, fossils that record how such a giant galaxy grew.

claims.text: NGC 3842 is the brightest cluster galaxy of Abell 1367
NGC 3842 is a giant elliptical galaxy
NGC 3842 has a central black hole of 9.7 billion solar masses
NGC 3842 is a target of Hubble program 15265 (MASSIVE+), which studies globular cluster systems
Hubble program 15265 studies the globular cluster systems of the most massive MASSIVE Survey galaxies to trace their growth histories
